name: BetterRack
description: Desktop app for organizing and reading a local comic book library (CBR/CBZ), with built-in search, downloads and wiki metadata lookups.

scripts.start: tsc && bun run build && bun run ./src/run.ts
scripts.start:fresh: tsc && bun run build && bun run refresh && bun run ./src/run.ts
scripts.start-react: tsc && bun run build-react && bun run ./src/run.ts
scripts.start-react:fresh: tsc && bun run build-react && bun run refresh && bun run ./src/run.ts
scripts.start-app: bun run build:react:electron && bun run build-app && electron .
scripts.start-app:fresh: bun run build:react:electron && bun run build-app && bun run refresh && electron .
scripts.start-app:client: bun run build:client:electron && bun run build-app && CLIENT_DIST_DIR=./client/dist electron .
scripts.build:react:electron: cd react && pnpm run build -- --mode electron
scripts.build:client:electron: cd client && pnpm run build -- --mode electron
scripts.build-app: bun build ./electron/main.ts --outfile dist/main.js --target node --format esm --external electron && bun build ./electron/preload.ts --outfile dist/preload.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron
scripts.dist: bun run build:react:electron && bun run build-app && bun run build-server && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win nsis --publish=never
scripts.dist:linux: bun run build:react:electron && bun run build-app && bun run build-server:linux && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --linux AppImage --publish=never
scripts.dist:client: bun run build:client:electron && bun run build-app && bun run build-server && ELECTRON_FRONTEND=client electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win nsis --publish=never
